Class PlannerController

java.lang.Object
mvc.AbstractController
planner.ui.PlannerController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Controller
public class PlannerController extends AbstractController
Controller for the student planner application. Handles user interactions and coordinates between the view and service layer.
